name: self_healing_gate
description:
Deterministic, fixture-only self-healing decision gate as a single triage
node. The model proposes exactly one typed diagnosis (fault_class, evidence,
candidate_remediation); this workflow owns the fault classification, evidence
verification, action permission, priority, cooldown, rate limit, blast radius,
rollback and terminal-state handling. Port of
code/qwen_vm/app_scenarios/self_healing_gate.
The deterministic classifier is a fixed evidence-priority chain (crash_loop
beats deployment_changed+error_rate_high beats dependency_timeout beats
traffic_above_capacity beats zone_unhealthy beats memory_growth beats
unknown). A malformed / injected / unknown-action proposal folds into one
schema choice and is rejected before anything else. The service state machine
(DEGRADED -> STABILIZING / RECOVERED / ROLLED_BACK / TERMINAL) folds into one
service_state choice; the terminal set {recovered, rolled_back, terminal} is
denied re-entry. The per-service+action cooldown and the per-window rate limit
are clock/history state and fold into one stream choice. The in-memory effect
(action_success / recovered / rollback_success) folds into one effect choice.
Emitted labels: reject_diagnosis, deny_terminal, escalate_human,
defer_cooldown, defer_rate_limit, execute_stabilizing, execute_recovered,
execute_rolled_back, execute_terminal.

proposal_schema.instructions: Is the model's proposal one schema-valid typed diagnosis (exactly fault_class / evidence / candidate_remediation, all enum values, non-empty known evidence and one known candidate remediation)?

criteria.accepted: exactly one valid typed diagnosis proposal
criteria.rejected: malformed, injected/unknown field, unknown enum, or unknown action

service_state.instructions: Lifecycle state of the target service before this incident.

criteria.stabilizing: a prior action is still stabilising

evidence.instructions: Is every proposed evidence key non-empty and actually present in the incident fixture (no invented key)?

criteria.pass: all proposed evidence is fixture-backed and non-empty
criteria.fail: empty evidence or at least one invented key

fault.instructions: Does the proposed fault_class match the deterministic classifier's fault class for this fixture?

permission.instructions: Is the deterministic fault class allowed by the candidate action's policy (restart->process_crash, drain_bad_instance->memory_leak, rollback_deployment->deployment_regression, failover->dependency_latency or zone_isolation, scale_out->traffic_overload)?

criteria.pass: the action is permitted for this fault
criteria.fail: the action is not allowed for this fault

stream.instructions: Per service+action history: is the action clear of the cooldown (ticks since the last action >= cooldown) and under the rate limit (window count < limit)?

criteria.idle: outside cooldown and under the rate limit
criteria.cooldown: an identical action ran within the cooldown window
criteria.rate_limited: the rate-limit window already holds the max count

blast.instructions: Blast radius: is this a protected service about to receive a service-wide (non single-instance) action?

criteria.escalate: service-wide action on a protected service

effect.instructions: In-memory effect of executing the action (fixture only).
